# Who owes you money, how late is it, and who always pays slow?

> Free analyzer for freelancers, agencies and small businesses: load an invoice export from QuickBooks, FreshBooks, Wave, Xero or a spreadsheet and see accounts receivable aging, days sales outstanding, how long each client really takes to pay, the cost of late payment and when the open balance is likely to arrive.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
